messages:
alex: Heads-up — need to lock PRD gating + canary matrix for the external tenant-pin request. Meeting tomorrow 11:00. Quick sync here on acceptance criteria and rollout plan.

maria: ok — high level what are we being asked to guarantee by the customer? uptime/latency/consistency?

alex: customer wants guaranteed model version pin per-tenant + SLA for 99th latency under 350ms for text-gen routes. Also strict data isolation and a rollback window.

ken: for pinning we should allow TTL-based pins (30d default) and an admin override. Edge case: tenant requests pin to a model that’s EOL — we should reject and suggest a compatible fallback.

tara: acceptance criteria proposal:
- correctness: model outputs should not regress on our regression prompt set by >5% QA score
- perf: p99 <350ms and p50 <120ms under normal load
- reliability: zero catastrophic failures; error rate <0.2% during rollout
- cost: per-token cost delta <20% vs baseline

maria: +1 to putting the regression prompts in the PRD. Also need clear rollback triggers.

ken: rollback triggers I suggest:
1) sustained p99 latency breach for 10m above threshold
2) error rate spike >1% for 5m
3) quality regression detected by automated eval on canary set (>5% failures)

alex: rollout schedule draft: `0.5% -> 3% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%` with 30m observation windows at first two stages, 60m afterwards. manual gate before 40%.

tara: add a quick rollback policy: if triggered at any gate, auto-switch to pinned-fallback model and pause further ramp. Ops notified.

devops-bot: deploy-template v2 ready. Sample canary config:
```json
{
  "ramp": [0.5, 3, 10, 40, 100],
  "windows_minutes": [30, 30, 60, 60, 0],
  "auto_rollback": true
}
```

maria: how do we handle tenant-level pin expiry? auto-unpin would be messy. Proposal: send alerts at 7/2/0 days to tenant admins and require explicit renewal; system should default to last-compatible minor variant after expiry.

ken: agree. Also add a safety net: if pinned model is removed from catalog, immediate failover to last-compatible and create an incident for model-onboarding.

alex: ok action items: (1) I will draft PRD sections for acceptance criteria and rollback triggers, (2) ken will write pin TTL/override spec + failure modes, (3) tara will own observability templates and the canary ramp timings, (4) maria will add customer communication flow (renewal alerts).

maria: I'll also add the regression prompt set and evaluation script to the PRD so tests are reproducible.

ken: will document EOL/fallback mapping in model catalog metadata.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll post the PRD draft later today and tag this thread. pls review before the 11am sync. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: reminder — canary-templates repo updated at 1813456900 by @devops-bot.
